content.title: US Stock Market Timings - NYSE, NASDAQ, Dow Jones
content.text: 6326 3 mins read 28-March-2026 A stock market is a secure place where investors and traders can buy and sell stocks of the company listed on the exchange. As one of the strongest economies in the world, the US stock market attracts investors from different geographies who wish to diversify their portfolios and invest in some of the major global companies listed on the US exchanges. However, to buy and sell securities listed on the US stock exchange, you must be familiar with US stock market timings. In this article, we highlight US market timings for when the US stock market opens, trading hours, and timing conversions as per IST. What is US share market time or trading hours? The US stock market operates from 9:30 AM to 4:00 PM EST US stock market open time (7:00 PM to 1:30 AM IST for Indian investors). These hours cover the business times of the NASDAQ and the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE). From March to November. Daylight Saving Time (DST) shifts trading hours an hour earlier. The standard trading hours for the NYSE and NASDAQ, excluding holidays, are Monday through Friday. Additionally, certain equities are available for pre-market and after-hours trading from 4:00 AM to 8:00 PM EST. However, these sessions carry higher risks due to lower liquidity and increased volatility. Investing in US stocks can diversify portfolios and provide a hedge against INR depreciation. Although the US has more than ten stock exchanges, trading activity is largely concentrated on two major platforms. The New York Stock Exchange and NASDAQ dominate listings, liquidity, and global influence, shaping capital markets through their scale, history, and technological evolution for investors, issuers, and policymakers worldwide today in practice.The US stock market has over 10 stock exchanges, but NYSE and NASDAQ are the most prominent.Founded in 1792, the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) is based on Wall Street.NYSE is the world’s largest stock exchange by market capitalisation, exceeding $25 trillion as of December 2023.The NYSE is owned by Intercontinental Exchange (ICE).Established in 1971, NASDAQ is the world’s first fully electronic stock exchange.NASDAQ is the second-largest exchange globally, with 3,584 listed companies as of December 2023.It is owned by NASDAQ Inc. and headquartered at One Liberty Plaza, New York.Both stock exchanges operate during standard US stock market trading hours, which are similar to those of other major global exchanges:TimingsNYSENASDAQPre-market trading hours4.00 AM to 9.30 AM (ET)4.00 AM to 9.30 AM (ET)Normal trading hours9.30 AM to 4 PM (ET)9.30 AM to 4 PM (ET)After-hours trading4.00 PM to 8 PM (ET)4.00 PM to 8 PM (ET)Note: While provisions for pre-trading hours exist, when we talk about US stock market timings, it refers to normal trading hours. In other words, the US stock market opens at 9:30 AM ET on all working days (no trading happens on Saturday and Sunday).Understanding the Eastern Time ZoneUS stock market timings are based on the Eastern Time Zone or ET. When discussing ET and the US market opening time, it is important to consider the following variables:Eastern Standard Time (EST): EST is observed during the autumn and winter months. It is 5 hours behind the Coordinated Universal Time (UTC-5) or Greenwich Mean Time.Eastern Daylight Time (EDT): EDT is observed in the spring and summer months. Due to daylight savings, EDT is 4 hours behind the Coordinated Universal Time (UTC-4) or Greenwich Mean Time.See the latest updates on why share market down todayWhile the US stock market opens according to Eastern Time, it is essential for Indian investors to modify their trading schedules according to the Indian Standard Time (IST). In other words, Indian investors need to consider the time difference between India and the US to understand share market timings. Thus, for investors in India, US stock markets open in the evening at 7:00 PM IST and close at 1:30 AM IST.The following table sums up the US stock market timings in IST:ExchangePre-market trading hours (IST)Regular trading hours (IST)After-hours tradingNYSE1:30 PM to 7:00 PM7:00 PM to 1:30 AM1:30 AM to 5:30 AMNASDAQ1:30 PM to 7:00 PM7:00 PM to 1:30 AM1:30 AM to 5:30 AMList of US stock market holidaysRead the information in the table below to learn about the stock market holidays in the US, including full day-offs and limited working days.HolidaysDateNew Year’s DayJanuary 1, 2026Martin Luther King, Jr. DayJanuary 19, 2026President's DayFebruary 16, 2026Good FridayApril 3, 2026Memorial DayMay 25, 2026Juneteenth National Independence DayJune 19, 2026Independence DayJuly 3, 2026Labor DaySeptember 7, 2026Thanksgiving DayNovember 26, 2026Christmas DayDecember 25, 2026Please note the following about the information provided above:Every market mentioned closes at 1:30 PM (1:15 PM for a few eligible options) every Friday. Also, the market closes at this time on the day after Thanksgiving (November 26th, 2026).From 1 PM, crossing session orders are taken, and continuous executions are done until 1:30 PM on the above-mentioned days. For some platforms like NYSE National, NYSE Arca Equities, NYSE Chicago, and NYSE American Equities, there are late trading sessions that continue until 5 PM.The timings above are in ESTThe dates of holidays in the table are for the year 2026. Typically, federal holidays that fall over a weekend are celebrated on the working day right after it. This is why Christmas Day will be celebrated on December 25th, 2026.You may also be interested to knowHow to Invest in US Stocks from IndiaSome Basic Stock Market TermsHow Does Stock Market Work in IndiaShare Market Timings in IndiaHow to Select Stocks For IntradayMajor Global Stock Exchanges and Their Trading Timings in ISTAs we know, Indian stock markets operate from 9:15 a.m. to 3:30 p.m. (IST). Beyond India, several stock exchanges function across the world, each with its own trading hours.Major global exchanges include the New York Stock Exchange, London Stock Exchange, Shanghai Stock Exchange, Swiss Exchange, and NASDAQ. Most exchanges operate from Monday to Friday and remain closed on Saturdays, Sundays, and on officially declared trading holidays.Exchange NameCountryOpening time (in IST)Closing time (in IST)NYSEUSA7 PM1:30 AMNASDAQUSA7 PM1:30 AMLondon Stock ExchangeUK1:30 PM10 PMHong Kong Stock ExchangeHong Kong6:45 AM1:30 PMShanghai Stock ExchangeChina7 AM12:30 PMSIX Swiss ExchangeSwitzerland1:30 PM10 PMTaiwan Stock ExchangeTaiwan6:30 AM11 AMJapan Exchange GroupJapan5:30 AM11:30 AMA few more facts about US stock market timeVarious factors have caused disruptions in the workings of the stock markets of the United States in the past. Some noteworthy instances were:The NYSE was closed after the September 11th, 2001 terrorist attacks in the US for four consecutive sessions. The day being a Tuesday, NYSE resumed on the next Monday.The NYSE was also closed in 2012 due to Hurricane Sandy, which lasted for two days. The storm ended up causing damages worth more than US $70 billion.In disruptive situations like these, stock markets are expected to resume operations as soon as situations normalise.ConclusionWhile the US stock market serves as a barometer to measure the economic health of the country, it also serves as an indicator of global financial health. Investors keep an eye on the US markets because movements in these markets can significantly impact global financial trends, affecting economies and portfolios worldwide. As an Indian investor, if you wish to diversify your portfolio with US stock investments, it is crucial to understand the US stock market timings. Knowing when the US stock markets open and close is essential for the timely execution of trades and can help you capitalise on market movements. Frequently asked questions On all working days, the normal trading sessions of the US stock markets commence at 7:00 PM IST, and the Indian investors can trade until 1:30 AM IST. After-market hours refer to trading that takes place after the regular market session ends. In the US stock markets, after-hours trading begins at 4:00 p.m. Eastern Time and may continue until as late as 8:00 p.m. ET. The US stock market timings for the after-market trading start from 4:00 PM ET and close at 8:00 PM ET. Essentially, after-market trading begins once the regular trading session ends at 4:00 PM ET.
